d: Bihar vidhan parishad ke aath navnirvachit sadasyon ke shapath grahan samaroh ke dauran loktantr ki ek sukhad aur sauhardapurn tasvir dekhne ko mili. samaroh men manch par mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri aur any mantri maujud the, jabki neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav ke baithne ki vyavastha niche ki gaee thi.
